title: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; docs site updates
author: Priya Khandelwal
release_notes:
- Added RAG agent templates and two quickstarts (Python, TypeScript).
- Docs site updated with a new RAG quickstart guide and sidebar entries.
- Examples demonstrate tool-calling patterns for search, DB lookups, and action execution.
description: Motivation: make RAG + agent/tool-calling patterns discoverable and easy to run for developers onboarding to Redwood. This PR adds a small library of RAG templates, two quickstarts (Python and TypeScript) demonstrating end-to-end retrieval-augmented generation with agent tool-calling, and docs site updates (guide, sidebar, screenshots) to surface the examples. Checklist: [x] Add RAG templates under examples/rag/templates; [x] Add quickstarts under examples/rag/quickstarts (python, typescript); [x] Update docs/guides/rag-agent-quickstart.md with code snippets and security guidance; [x] Add docs/_data/sidebar.yml entries and redirects; [x] Update packages/agent README to link examples; [x] Fix CI lint failures and rerun tests. Related tickets: ENG-1284 (RAG templates), DOC-342 (docs site), PM-58 (quickstart prioritization). Notes: the quickstarts are intentionally small (single-file app + README) and include sample prompts, retrieval pipeline wiring, and an example tool registry. The docs section includes a short security note on tool-calling privileges and recommended RBAC policies.
